Subject: Dedicated capacity — sizing & preferred start window

Kim — thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the example workload against our staging traces and we think Dedicated makes sense given predictability needs. A few items we need to understand before we can move forward: 

- Preferred commit terms you offer (12/24/36) and the typical discount curve per term.
- Whether we can stage the GPU pool (start at 40% and ramp to 100% over 6 months).
- Guarantees: can you commit to throughput (tokens/sec) and p95 latency at selected pool sizes?
- Start date constraints — our procurement needs the capacity to be live by 2027-04-01, but we could be flexible by ±3 weeks.

Attached is a short workbook with our projected Q2 volume and traces (Nebula_Ramp_Requirements.xlsx). Curious if you can share a term-level proposal and an example ramp schedule that matches our fiscal calendar.

Thanks — Asha
Senior ML Platform Manager
Nebula Systems

Asha — really appreciate the workbook, that was helpful. Quick summary and ask: 

- Term options: we support 12/24/36 month reserved commits. Typical list discounts (off our hosted unit price) are roughly: 12mo = 10% off, 24mo = 18% off, 36mo = 25% off. We can improve those with higher committed GPU-hours or by taking on a larger upfront deposit.
- Staged onramp: yes — we can structure a phased schedule (e.g., 40% -> 70% -> 100% over 6 months). We generally guarantee throughput for the effective pool size after the stage completes.
- Start date: 2027-04-01 looks feasible depending on regional capacity; we have a soft start window of +/- 21 days.

I want to loop in Dev (technical sizing) and Hannah (commercial/SLA) to propose a firm, payable term sheet and a ramp calendar aligned to your procurement. Dev — can you confirm the p95 latency and throughput guarantees we can promise for the 40%/70%/100% pools with Nebula's trace profile?

Next step: I can send a term sheet draft + illustrative pricing by Friday if that works. If so, any preference on billing cadence (monthly usage true-up vs quarterly invoicing)?

—Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, Asha Verma <asha@nebulasys.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — sizing & preferred start window

Hi all — I ran Nebula's staging traces through our example 8x A100 equivalent pool sizing. Important notes: 

- Effective pool sizes (40%/70%/100%) correspond to 8, 14, and 20 concurrent model workers in our config.
- Throughput: with batching profile from the workbook, expected token/sec (aggregated across pool) is ~11k / 19k / 27k respectively. These are conservative numbers assuming 8k token median request lengths.
- Latency: for the batch-friendly paths we can hold p95 latency around 220ms (40%), ~260ms (70%), ~320ms (100%) for standard highway models. Specialized low-latency kernels can cut p95 by ~30% but may change effective throughput.
- Guarantees & SLAs: we can guarantee the throughput and p95 once the pool is provisioned and warmed (usually 72 hours after the phase start). Guarantees require two conditions: (1) pinned model version for the duration of the phase, and (2) a staging-to-prod warmup run (we'll coordinate a warmup deployment window).

I'll add a short appendix to the term sheet with the exact throughput numbers and the warmup checklist. We should also capture a rollback/fallback clause in case we need to temporarily scale back due to hardware maintenance.

—Dev
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_Dedicated_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: Asha Verma <asha@nebulasys.com>, Ravi Kapoor <r.kapoor@nebulasys.com>

Date: Tue, 8 Feb 2027 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Final proposal: phased 24-month commit + onramp calendar (Nebula Systems)

Asha / Ravi — putting the proposal on your desk per our calls. High level: 

- Term: 24-month reserved commit (preferred balance for Nebula given projected growth).
- Commit size: Equivalent to 12 x A100 (baseline pool). Phased ramp: Month 0–2 = 40% (4.8 A100 equiv), Month 3–5 = 70% (8.4 A100 equiv), Month 6+ = 100% (12 A100 equiv).
- Commercials: 18% off hosted unit price with a 1-month refundable deposit to reserve capacity (we can reduce deposit with a 36-month upfront). Final unit rates and invoice milestones are in the attached term sheet.
- Guarantees: throughput and p95 as outlined by Dev; guarantees start after warmup window (72h). We include one scheduled maintenance window per quarter with 99.9% uptime target.
- Start date: target April 1, 2027 with ±21 day flexibility. We will prioritize Nebula in the us-west region and lock capacity once the signed term sheet and deposit are received.

Next steps: 
1) Review term sheet (attached) and confirm preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly).
2) If acceptable, sign via DocuSign link below and we'll provision the initial phase.
